设置支持查询、空补丁和局部修改，并广播完整设置。

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "settings.get",
  "requestId": "settings",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "settings.get",
  "requestId": "settings",
  "data": {
    "playMode": "sequential"
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "settings.set",
  "requestId": "empty-patch",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "settings.set",
  "requestId": "empty-patch",
  "data": {
    "playMode": "sequential"
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "settings.set",
  "requestId": "set-mode",
  "data": {
    "playMode": "random"
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "settings.set",
  "requestId": "set-mode",
  "data": {
    "playMode": "random"
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "settings.updated",
  "data": {
    "playMode": "random"
  }
}
